entities.name: Vervamon the Elder
entities.description: A sage and scholar of the Dark Age on Dominaria who worked for the Academy of Egaverral and was burned at the stake by the Church of Tal.

entities.name: Maeveen O'Donagh
entities.description: Vervamon's captain.

entities.name: Quopomma
entities.description: Lieutenant to Maeveen.

entities.name: Iro
entities.description: Lieutenant to Maeveen.

entities.name: Pioni
entities.description: Estranged wife of Lord Peemel who bore Vervamon's son.

entities.name: Lord Peemel of Iwset
entities.description: Ruler of Iwset who schemed over the city's sigil.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Vervamon's unknown son, smuggled away as an infant; inheritor of the sigil of Iwset.

entities.name: Tavora
entities.description: Elf and Peemel's majordomo who smuggled Yunnie away.

entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: Sorcerer working for Digody.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Peemel's advisor.

entities.name: Academy of Egaverral
entities.description: Institution Vervamon worked for.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Intolerant church that burned Vervamon at the stake.

entities.name: Niroso
entities.description: Mysterious liquid stone people who live underground.

entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: City ruled by Lord Peemel.

entities.name: Shingol
entities.description: Fishing village where Yunnie was taken.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: Valley where the Niroso live.

entities.name: Tomb of the Seven Martyrs
entities.description: Tomb whose key was supposedly Iwset's sigil.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: City the group was sent toward.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent Vervamon explored.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where Vervamon lived.

events.summary: Vervamon encounters Lady Pioni, who becomes pregnant and bears Yunnie.
events.quote: Pioni fell pregnant after their encounter

events.summary: Tavora smuggles the infant Yunnie away from Iwset to Shingol to save him from Peemel's rage.
events.quote: offered to smuggle the child away from Iwset

events.summary: Vervamon leads expeditions across Terisiare facing numerous dangers.
Peemel claims the city's sigil is the key to the Tomb of the Seven Martyrs, drawing the group into his schemes.
events.quote: They became embroiled in the schemes of Lord Peemel of Iwset

events.summary: Coernn sends the group toward the City of Shadows.
events.quote: sent the group towards the City of Shadows

events.summary: Maeveen rescues Yunnie, and the group travels to the Urhaalan Valley where Vervamon meets the Niroso.
events.quote: the group traveled into the Urhaalan Valley

events.summary: Vervamon becomes a teacher for the Niroso while learning the secrets of the earth.
events.quote: Vervamon then became a teacher for the Niroso

events.summary: Vervamon is burned at the stake by the Church of Tal.
events.quote: he was burned at the stake under suspicion of being a sorcerer

relations.note: father and son; Vervamon never knew
relations.quote: Vervamon did not learn from Maeveen the existence of his son Yunnie
Vervamon worked for the Academy of Egaverral
He was later burned at the stake by the intolerant Church of Tal
